Results.ReviewText:
Pros= cooks very good! ash collecting pan system works great. Kettle finish is very nice, strong and durable
Im  no pro, but I find the grill legs height are a bit short and have a  flimsy feel at the kettle leg socket. Also the height from the cooking surface to the lid/dome top could be a little higher / taller to accommodate a whole chicken. Also, wish the whole grill was an inch or two higher off the ground maybe longer legs  legs. and sturdier leg inserts in the kettle itself...
Results.Title: Pros and cons

Results.ReviewText: I have always used propane and took a big leap of faith trying this charcoal grill. The first time was a huge learning curve, but the second go was smooth! I absolutely love it! The flavor is unmatched. I do wish the "hook" to hang the lid was a little more prominent, I typically just set it on the ground instead. Completely happy and will probably never go back to propane!
Results.Title: I'm a convert!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill,  we love the charcoal flavor so we returned to the kettle grill after years of using a gas grill.
Results.Title: Smokin

Results.ReviewText: I went back to a 22" Kettle after several years with a different brand off-set smoker/ charcoal grill. Never liked it much and didn't work as well as a Weber. Better heat control and more efficient on charcoal.
Results.Title: Glad to have a Weber again

Results.ReviewText: Very well built. I replaced my old Weber with this one I had for over 5 years. It was time to get a new one and this new Weber is built as heavy and well made as the old one.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill Ever.

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect. The very first cook I did was a brisket that came out spectacular. Really easy to maintain the perfect temperature for those slow cooks. Amazing.
Results.Title: The King of Kettle Grills

Results.ReviewText: I have only used it a few times and mostly happy with it. Except that I wish the lid fit onto the base a little better. If its not set just right your fire will be 100*-200* higher than intended. Resulting in potentially burnt food. So I wish Weber would address that. Otherwise I think it’s a great cooker for those who want to cook “hot & fast”.
Results.Title: Better for hot and fast than low and slow!??.

Results.ReviewText: Awesome easy to use. Easy to control heat, to add charcoal. Dual zone.
Results.Title: A little powerhouse

ClientResponses.Response:
We value your feedback. Your loyalty as a Weber fan is everything to us, and we are sorry to learn that you are not satisfied with your most recent grill purchase. 

Buildup inside the lid is a normal byproduct of grilling, and it can be easily cleaned off with a scraper or ball of aluminum foil. 

We would like to know more about your experience and offer our support. Please look for an email follow-up soon.
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: The Quality just isn’t there with Weber anymore. I’ve been a loyal Weber guy for 25+ years and had my grill for a year before it started pealing.  Weber says this is normal but it’s not. Had my previous Charcoal grill for over 5 years and it didn’t do that. They made a nice excuse to not replace it but you might as well spend less, quality will be the same now.
Results.Title: Disappointing

Results.ReviewText: Weber always stands for quality. Love the grill! One suggestion - the hook inside the lid that enables you to hang the lid on the side of the bowl is too short. It takes several attempts to find the perfect angle so the lid will hang. Surely an inch longer hook is not unrealistic or too costly!
Results.Title: Great grill, but could be better

Results.ReviewText: I use my Weber 22” charcoal grill at least twice a week and love it. I’ve replaced the internal parts only twice, but it was so easy and convenient to just call and talk with someone instead of all this new automation, quick easy and fast. Keep up the good work Weber
Results.Title: Weber Parts

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd webber grill. My first 2 were gift from my pops. Gave one away when I had the 2 at time. The last one was breaking apart; so I bought this one. Too bad not everything could be fixed, because the bowl was still intact on my old one. The control temp on the bottom, was what broke and that is easy to break on these.
Results.Title: It’s a good gift

Results.ReviewText: We love our Weber grill so much. It is the perfect size and the color is great. We have made multiple dinners with our grill and it has been fantastic each time!
Results.Title: Love this grill!

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill! Assembly was easy - everything worked fine.  Used five or six times so far and it’s just a joy, but then my other Webber’s were as well! The only negative thing I have to say is that the ash catcher really doesn’t fit the way it should, so it’s difficult to put on and it comes off really easy. Other than that fantastic grill!
Results.Title: Really Cookin

Results.ReviewText: I own a gas grill and pellet smoker also but charcoal is the best.
Results.Title: Mad dog

Results.ReviewText: On my 3rd cook with my Kettle.  Easy to maintain and keep temp using my dampers. Love the way it retains heat.
Results.Title: First Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText: I am 100% satisfied with my weber grill. It holds the heat really well and cooks my steaks and burgers perfectly.
Results.Title: 22 inch original weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill except the legs are too short! They need to be another 4 or 5 inches long.
Results.Title: Great grill expect legs too short

Results.ReviewText: This is my second 22” Weber kettle and enjoy the flexibility of this style of grill. With all the available accessories, the Weber kettle is definitely a versatile grilling tool that you simply cannot overlook. I’m over six feet tall so the grill is a little short for me. I know why Weber doesn’t make them taller, but it would be nice if they would. All-in-all, you simply cannot go wrong with any Weber kettle grill.
Results.Title: Versatile Weapon in My Grilling Arsenal

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Best one out there lasts forever. Usually I get a new grill every 5-10 years
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: I have owned Weber grills for 30 years and have found it to be the best product of all.
Results.Title: 22" Original Kettle

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. The damper handle is available on select charcoal grill models. We apologize for the inconvenience this has caused you. Our Care Team will reach out to assist you with your concern. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText:
Can’t even believe Weber has gotton So cheap as to not include a heat resistant handle on the damper. 
Support says I can order a part from 26” kettle for the low price of 21.99
Results.Title: Seriously Weber?

Results.ReviewText: I like the Original kettle and have beennusing the charcoal model for almost 50 years. This is my 4th one and it lacks a back handle. It is much more difficult to move as I have steps involved from where its kept to where Its used.
Results.Title: CS review

Results.ReviewText: Always like these Weber grills.  This is my 4 th one. Works great. Temp gauge hard to trust in a kettle style grill.
Results.Title: Weber kettle grill.

ClientResponses.Response:
We value your feedback! We understand your concerns, and we want to help improve your experience. Temperature control on a charcoal grill can take some practice to master, but learning how to grill with a different fuel type always has a learning curve. 

We hope to get you grilling like a pro on your new charcoal grill very soon. Please look for an email follow-up from our Care team. We'll provide some grilling tips and ensure your feedback reaches the right teams. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText:
The kettle is well made, but here are some things that have frustrated me:
---It requires much more charcoal that I expected to get it up to temperature
---The ash pan is fine, except that it is hard to put on.  It fell off and made a terrible mess on my patio
---Hanging the lid on the side is not easy
---Time required to cook a meal is much longer than with gas because of the amount of time required to start the charcoal.   Using a chimney style starter requires about 45 minutes, not the 20 minutes seen in videos.
---Temperature control is much more difficult than with gas grill.
---Bottom Line:  I wish I had bought a gas grill.
Results.Title: Not exactly what I expected

Results.ReviewText: I received a 22” Copper kettle for Christmas and it’s been an excellent experience so far! Unfortunately, due to shipping my lid had a good sized dent that took the paint off which was a bit of a bummer. Upon contacting customer service I was sent a new lid quickly covered under warranty! You couldn’t have asked for better customer service, especially from Emily! She was great, coming off genuinely friendly and caring. The copper color is amazing and the best one available in my opinion. The kettle goes together quickly and easily! It holds heat great and the food that comes off it is delicious! I prefer to use it over my smoker or griddle due to its simplicity and easy cleanup. I can’t wait to own other Weber products in the future!
Results.Title: Great product, even better customer service!

Results.ReviewText: I received this new kettle to replace one that I've had for ever. The old one was actually beginning to rust through. It was well loved and lasted well over a decade. The new one seems to get hotter faster and might even cook a bit better. Im very happy with my new kettle. I hope it lasts as long as the last one.
Results.Title: A worthy replacement for my old "trusty-rusty"

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22". I still have and use my first Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22". I clearly favor the Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22" when it comes to cooking in the back yard. Can not say enough in regards to charcoal cooking with these fantastic grills.
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22"

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and the perfect design. Learning how to heat the coals effectively takes a bit but is easy to learn with some googling.
Results.Title: Easy to use and durable.

Results.ReviewText: The grill is great, as always. Before this one I had a one touch gold for 14 years. The thing I miss with the new design is having two handles. Why'd you go down to one?
Results.Title: Hated to Lose the Second Handle

Results.ReviewText: Get one!  This thing has been the most fun for me and my son. We’ve cooked the best steaks, hamburgers and hotdogs, ribs, and even a pork butt. There are so many great YouTube videos about how to set it up for various cooking methods, it’s really been a great learning experience for my 14 year old son. The time it takes to get the charcoal ready, monitoring the temperature, playing with the vents to get it dialed in, all a lot of fun. Slow down and enjoy a classic, you won’t regret it. The flavor is awesome, the sear on the steaks is restaurant good, and how fun to smoke some ribs in an afternoon with your kids. Get your son out of the house and teach him the time honored traditions of grilling.
Results.Title: Best father and son activity going!

Results.ReviewText: I have returned to Webber grilling. As a young married man I started with a Webber grill, just like my dad had taught me. Over the years I had several of the base model grills always pleased with it cooking. But as I got older I got tired of the “hassle” of starting the fire so went gas grill. After it finally rusted out I’m back to an upgraded Webber grill. At 72 years of age I expect it to be my last grill, finishing with the BEST!
Results.Title: Returning to the best…

Results.ReviewText: Love my Weber! Great product very simple and reliable.
Results.Title: Kettle 22”

Results.ReviewText: Have had a Weber for years.  IMHO, they make the best charcoal grills, period.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill works well. I am still learning, but have enjoyed the process quite a bit and the flavor even more!
Results.Title: Perfect for someone new to charcoal grilling!

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
